notes.title: Update 2.1 - Gamepad Support and More!
notes.content:
[h2]Gamepad Support 🎮[/h2]  
Full gamepad support has been added for Xbox and PlayStation controllers. You can swap between keyboard/mouse and gamepad on the fly, and input bindings can be modified as usual in the Input menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33201553/07c4851af7f62949141f86d093002a0ad2dd5e49.png[/img]

[h2]Additional Improvements ➕[/h2]  
Input binding UI has been added to the metro for easier reference of the train functions. The character select UI has been improved, and several other changes and improvements have been made that can be viewed in the changelist below.

[h2]Changelist[/h2]
• Added full gamepad support
• Added new notifications for metro input assistance
• Added names and profiles to character select UI
• Added input binding UI for metro train
• Revised map UI
• Revised phone app UI
• Revised cursor and crosshair graphics
• Revised metro fire suppression logic
• Revised some loading screen images
• Improved lighting quality
• Fixed incorrect apparel items sometimes being unequipped when stored
• Fixed cursor issues
• Fixed some mismatched pedestrian LOD materials
• Fixed inconsistent item image backgrounds
• Fixed alarm app not working
• Fixed "Fashionable" achievement not working
• Fixed "Plushie Lover" achievement not working
• Fixed office tower and casino not opening at correct time
• Fixed several lighting/shadow issues
• Fixed several localization issues

[h2]Thank You ❤️[/h2]  
Thank you for your support and feedback during Metro Sim Hustle's development! Please visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/882250/discussions/]community forums[/url] to share any suggestions or bug reports you may have.  

If you enjoyed Metro Sim Hustle, you might be interested in Denizen!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2010030/Denizen/

notes.title: Update 2.0 - Metro Sim Hustle Overhaul!
notes.content:
Update 2.0 for Metro Sim Hustle is here! This update brings several enhancements, fixes, and additions designed to improve the gameplay experience.

[h2]User Interface 🖥️[/h2]  
All user interfaces have been redesigned with a modern appearance and improved text legibility. The HUD now includes funds and time of day for better in-game tracking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33201553/03c8e60062200e6bc83d37901f4bdff487b1613f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33201553/f351d13782ff62366c3b3cecc2a57df9600ce09b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33201553/6c18a52252086225714b047ab1e62b2945e2074b.png[/img]  

[h2]Gameplay Enhancements 🎮[/h2]  
Context menu interactions have been added to all in-game stores, making item purchases and interactions more intuitive.  

Tutorial and loading content has been revised to provide clearer guidance for new players, and an improved character select screen has been added.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33201553/0fbb4a332202b6fcdcab1d6692843834b2fb0013.png[/img]  

[h2]Visuals 🌄[/h2]  
Weather, sky, and lighting systems have been overhauled for enhanced graphics. Various textures and materials have been refined, and post-processing effects and realtime shadows have been upgraded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33201553/07c4851af7f62949141f86d093002a0ad2dd5e49.png[/img]  

[h2]Localization 🌐[/h2]  
Localization support has been added for the following languages:  
• French  
• Italian  
• German  
• Spanish  
• Dutch  
• Japanese  
• Polish  
• Russian  
• Simplified Chinese  
• Turkish  
• Brazilian Portuguese  

[h2]Performance Improvements and Fixes ⚙️[/h2]  
Loading times have been reduced for a faster and smoother experience. Optimizations to dynamic lighting and overall performance ensure better stability across hardware configurations.  

Several fixes have been made for commonly reported issues, which can be viewed in the changelist below.  

[h2]Changelist[/h2]  
• Added context menu interaction to all stores  
• Added funds and time of day to HUD  
• Added full localization for 11 additional languages  
• Revised all user interfaces  
• Revised and added missing item descriptions  
• Revised loading screen content  
• Revised tutorial content  
• Revised character dialogue  
• Revised various materials and textures  
• Revised main menu scene  
• Revised foliage  
• Revised post-processing effects  
• Revised movement and sprint speed  
• Improved lighting, sky, and realtime shadow quality  
• Improved loading times  
• Fixed camera hitching that could occur on some hardware  
• Fixed player gravity/floating when traveling up stairs  
• Fixed potential for player to fall through floor  
• Fixed leaderboards sometimes not initializing  
• Fixed some audio clips repeatedly playing, or not playing at all  
• Fixed inventory and containers sometimes displaying incorrect item quantities  
• Fixed phone lock screen sometimes displaying incorrect day of week  
• Fixed dynamic model lighting issues  
• Fixed attack and block commands sometimes not registering in arena  
• Fixed some saved settings not initializing  
• Fixed an issue with narcotic production logic  
• Fixed several issues with input remapping  

[h2]Coming Soon[/h2]  
• Full gamepad support  
• Additional fixes and enhancements  

[h2]Thank You ❤️[/h2]  
Thank you for your support and feedback during Metro Sim Hustle's development! Please visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/882250/discussions/]community forums[/url] to share any suggestions or bug reports you may have.  

If you enjoyed Metro Sim Hustle, you might be interested in Denizen!  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2010030/Denizen/

notes.title: 1.0 Preview
notes.content:
The 1.0 Preview is here! After over four years of development including a two year early access period, Metro Sim Hustle now feels much more like a real game than it did on the day it was initially released. It has been a journey, and the community has been immensely helpful and supportive along the way. A lot of love has gone into this game.

This update contains a big list of additions, revisions, and fixes that fulfill many requests and bug reports. The full 1.0 will contain additional changes, and it won't be the final update, so as always, you're welcome to leave your feedback in the forum. Enjoy!
